items.title: In new ticketing model, NFL aims for more Rolex, less T.J. Maxx
items.summary: NFL club business executives Schuyler Simpson and Bobby Gallo say the league's Ticketing 3.0 platform, powered by Ticketmaster under a seven-year deal, aims to personalise ticket buying around each fan's habits and history, with a launch hoped for before the 2027 schedule release in May. Bringing more transactions into the official ecosystem gives the league more fan data, which it wants to share across partners such as Uber, Marriott and Amazon in a connected 'ring' rather than the current hub-and-spoke model. The league wants fans to go straight to NFL.com instead of searching for tickets, and Gallo said owning its own ticketing platform remains possible in the long term.
items.what_it_means: The NFL is treating ticket buying as the front door to a shared fan data asset that adds value for every league partner.

items.title: Top MLB promotions of 2026: Hot giveaways drew fans to ballparks
items.byline: David Broughton and Emma Grace Patrick
items.summary: SBJ's analysis of every MLB club's promotional schedule counted more than 10.6 million game-day giveaways in 2026 and more than 5,000 activations in total, with bobbleheads handed out at a record 204 games. About 20% of the 71.8 million fans who attended received a souvenir, sponsors put their logo on 72% of giveaways, and 44% of all promotions were sponsored. Specialty-ticket packages rose 31% on 2025 to 1,496, led by college-themed packages, and IP brands such as Hello Kitty activated at a record 240 games.
items.what_it_means: Baseball clubs are leaning harder on themed, sponsored reasons to attend, which turns the matchday itself into a sponsor and ticket product.

items.title: PWHL expands Takeover Tour to 19 North American markets
items.summary: The PWHL will take 24 games to 19 markets outside its teams' home cities this season in its most expansive Takeover Tour yet, with Halifax hosting three games and Denver, Philadelphia and Washington, D.C. two each. The aim is to put the league in front of more people and test the waters for future expansion, and every city has been in the expansion conversation at some point. Most games will be played in NHL buildings, starting at Capital One Arena on 2 January.
items.what_it_means: A women's league is using touring neutral-site games to build demand and gather evidence in markets before it commits to expansion.

items.title: Verizon renews LaLiga sponsorship amid World Cup years
items.summary: Verizon has renewed its sponsorship of LaLiga in the US and Canada under a new multiyear deal, its second renewal since the partnership began in 2019-20, and LaLiga North America says it is their largest agreement yet. Verizon is also hosting sweepstakes that give fans access to the league, a tactic it carried over from its NFL and World Cup work. LaLiga North America's Nicolas Garcia Hemme said brands that activate experientially, rather than only through marks or media buys, help the league grow fandom.
items.what_it_means: A sponsor is backing a foreign league's growth in the US between two World Cups, betting on soccer fandom that it can help build through fan access.

items.title: Mark Walter Sought $800M for Record-Breaking Sparks Sale
items.summary: New Padres owners Jose E. Feliciano and Kwanza Jones are on the verge of buying the WNBA's Los Angeles Sparks from Mark Walter for about $750 million, according to Front Office Sports sources, after Walter initially asked for $800 million. The deal, first reported by Sportico, would shatter the previous WNBA record for a majority control sale of $300 million.
items.what_it_means: The price of a WNBA franchise has more than doubled its previous record, a sign of how buyers now value women's sport as a commercial asset.

items.title: Sports Media Pod: The Pat McAfee Effect -- ESPN's younger audience has doubled
items.summary: On SBJ's Sports Media Podcast, ESPN Chairman Jimmy Pitaro defends Pat McAfee's impact on College GameDay, pointing to more than 100% growth among viewers aged 18 to 24 over four years. He explains why McAfee's energy, humour and connection with younger fans support ESPN's top long-term priority of expanding its audience.
items.what_it_means: ESPN is backing a personality to recruit younger viewers, treating audience growth as more important than protecting a traditional format.

items.title: ATP approves combining commercial assets into ATP Ventures, increasing player compensation
items.summary: The ATP Board and ATP Media shareholders unanimously approved ATP Ventures, which will bring ATP Media, Tennis Data Innovations and the tour's central sponsorship activity under one roof for the first time, aiming to start in 2028. The move is designed to speed up commercial growth and improve the experience for fans and for media, data and sponsor partners. The ATP also approved measures to lift total player compensation above $350 million from 2028.
items.what_it_means: Men's tennis is consolidating media, data and sponsorship into one commercial vehicle so partners can buy the tour as a single package.

items.title: Mammoth, Avalanche set combined Winter Classic merch record on Fanatics sites
items.summary: Fanatics says Utah Mammoth and Colorado Avalanche Winter Classic merchandise set a combined record in the first 24 hours after launch, at more than double the previous best Winter Classic launch. Both teams also passed the previous best-selling NHL jersey launch day, and eight of the top 10 selling products across all teams and leagues on Fanatics sites were for the Winter Classic.
items.what_it_means: A one-off event with its own look can drive record merchandise demand across a league's whole retail network.

items.title: NFL's Mexico fan base surges despite game hiatus ahead of 49ers-Vikings matchup
items.summary: NFL Mexico managing director Arturo Olive says the league's Mexican fan base has grown from about 10 million to 40 million over 18 years, even without a regular-season game there since 2022, and the NFL now trails only soccer in total fans. The league has invested heavily in flag football, which has about 4 million players, and signed an agreement with Mexico's federal sports agency to expand it in public schools. The 49ers, who hold NFL marketing rights in Mexico, are running fan events in Mexico City ahead of Sunday's game.
items.what_it_means: The NFL grew a market fourfold through year-round grassroots work, with the games themselves as occasional peaks.

items.title: Berman: NWSL using 2027 Challenge Cup to test Austin as expansion market
items.summary: NWSL Commissioner Jessica Berman announced the 2027 Challenge Cup will be played at Q2 Stadium in Austin, a non-NWSL market, which she framed as a chance to learn the fan base and test appetite for a potential expansion team. It is the second straight Challenge Cup at a neutral site, after Columbus hosted in 2026 before being awarded a $205 million expansion franchise. The league has added four teams since 2024, with two more due in 2028.
items.what_it_means: Women's leagues are using one-off events to measure demand in a market before selling it an expansion team.
